name: designer_tool
description: Interact with the user's live Webflow Designer session — select an element on the canvas or read which element is currently selected, navigate the canvas between pages and component canvases, switch to or read the current page, list a page's branches, read the current branch ID, parent page ID, and Designer mode, enter, exit, or inspect the current component view, and read all breakpoints (media queries) configured for the site.

siteId.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site (e.g., '580e63e98c9a982ac9b8b741'). Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

check_if_inside_component_view.description: Check if inside component view. this helpful to make changes to the component

anyOf.description: Run check_if_inside_component_view: Check if inside component view. this helpful to make changes to the component

close_component_view.description: Close a component instance view. it will close and open the page view.

anyOf.description: Run close_component_view: Close a component instance view. it will close and open the page view.

page_folder_name.description: The name of the page folder to create

page_folder_parent_id.description: The id of the parent page folder to create the page folder in

anyOf.description: Run create_page_folder: Create new page folder

get_all_breakpoints.description: Get all breakpoints (media queries) configured for the site, in cascade specificity order. Each breakpoint includes its id, name, minWidth, maxWidth, and whether it is the base breakpoint.

anyOf.description: Run get_all_breakpoints: Get all breakpoints (media queries) configured for the site, in cascade specificity order. Each breakpoint includes its id, name, minWidth, maxWidth, and whether it is the base breakpoint.

get_branch_parent_page_id.description: Get the parent page ID of the current page. For branch pages, returns the original page ID.

anyOf.description: Run get_branch_parent_page_id: Get the parent page ID of the current page. For branch pages, returns the original page ID.

get_current_branch_id.description: Get the branch ID of the current page, if it exists on a branch.

anyOf.description: Run get_current_branch_id: Get the branch ID of the current page, if it exists on a branch.

get_current_component.description: Get the component currently being edited on the canvas (in-context editing or component canvas). Returns null if on a regular page.

anyOf.description: Run get_current_component: Get the component currently being edited on the canvas (in-context editing or component canvas). Returns null if on a regular page.

get_current_mode.description: Get the current Webflow Designer mode. Returns one of 'design', 'build', 'preview', 'edit', 'comment', or null if it cannot be determined.

anyOf.description: Run get_current_mode: Get the current Webflow Designer mode. Returns one of 'design', 'build', 'preview', 'edit', 'comment', or null if it cannot be determined.

get_current_page.description: Get current page active on webflow designer

anyOf.description: Run get_current_page: Get current page active on webflow designer

get_selected_element.description: Get the element currently selected on the current active page in the Designer. Returns the selected element's id object ({component, element}) and the id of the current page (usable as pageId in data_element_tool calls) when an element is selected.

anyOf.description: Run get_selected_element: Get the element currently selected on the current active page in the Designer. Returns the selected element's id object ({component, element}) and the id of the current page (usable as pageId in data_element_tool calls) when an element is selected.

page_id.description: The id of the page to list branches for

list_branches.description: Discover all branches for a page by page ID.

anyOf.description: Run list_branches: Discover all branches for a page by page ID.

component_id.description: The id of the component to open in the canvas. Use this or page_id.

page_id.description: The id of the page to navigate to. Use this to exit the component canvas and return to a page.

open_canvas.description: Navigate the Designer canvas to a component or page. Use component_id to open a component canvas, or page_id to navigate to a page (e.g. to exit component canvas). Provide exactly one of component_id or page_id.

anyOf.description: Run open_canvas: Navigate the Designer canvas to a component or page. Use component_id to open a component canvas, or page_id to navigate to a page (e.g. to exit component canvas). Provide exactly one of component_id or page_id.

component.description: Component-scope ID. Pass the value of element.id.component verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

element.description: Element ID within the component scope. Pass the value of element.id.element verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

component_instance_id.description: Composite Designer element identifier. Always a two-field object — never a single string. Copy the `id` field verbatim from any Designer element returned by de_component_tool (get_all_components, get_component, get_current_component, get_parent_component) or element_tool (get_selected_element, query_elements, get_all_elements). Example: { component: "abc123", element: "def456" }.

open_component_view.description: Open a component instance view for changes or reading.

anyOf.description: Run open_component_view: Open a component instance view for changes or reading.

select_element.description: Select an element on the current active page in the Designer. Returns a confirmation message, the selected element's id object, and the id of the page the element lives on (usable as pageId in data_element_tool calls).

anyOf.description: Run select_element: Select an element on the current active page in the Designer. Returns a confirmation message, the selected element's id object, and the id of the page the element lives on (usable as pageId in data_element_tool calls).

page_id.description: The id of the page to switch to

switch_page.description: Switch to a page on webflow designer

anyOf.description: Run switch_page: Switch to a page on webflow designer

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: check_if_inside_component_view, close_component_view, create_page_folder, get_all_breakpoints, get_branch_parent_page_id, get_current_branch_id, get_current_component, get_current_mode, get_current_page, get_selected_element, list_branches, open_canvas, open_component_view, select_element, switch_page.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
